name: Advanced Baseline Imager Level 2 - Aerosol Optical Depth
description: Measures total columnar aerosol optical depth at 550 nm over land and ocean using ABI visible and near-infrared channels. Two Angstrom exponent fields characterise the wavelength dependence of aerosol extinction across the 0.47–0.86 μm and 0.86–1.61 μm band pairs.
